material.acceptance_criteria: Owner approves one call in server/src/lib.rs run(), or names another owned wiring site.
material.description: blocked_by gap-mod-effects-reach-served-room. Remote main 5de402ac: the only call site that hands a room to the ticker is server/src/lib.rs run() (spawn_ticker(Arc::clone(room), tick_budget), line 69) and the ModLink is created there (line 60). Room::new takes RoomConfig with no link; mods::spawn takes only the image, path, budget and link. Applying drained mod commands to the served room needs one call in lib.rs (e.g. room.attach_mod_feed(Arc::clone(&link)) for the served room), which is outside the owned paths (mods.rs, room.rs, ci.yml, the two accessors). Without it the drain lands inert.
material.subject: blocker: mod drain has no wiring site inside the owned files
material.witness: Attach-feed drain (room.rs tick boundary) on served room g8 at f8ab064: ev=mod_cmds room=g8 applied>=1. Output /tmp/gm-probe-17/out/g8-f8ab064.txt.
material.witness_plan: grep of remote lib.rs for spawn_ticker and ModLink::default shows the only wiring sites.
